role: AI workspace administration and stored chat-turn management (AnythingLLM-style)
known_patches: Raw filename anything-llm.spec.json mapped to app anything_llm; env_id changed to anything_llm
Integer admin persona User.id=1 and multi_user_mode config; remove compiler domain demo seeds
Add search and limit to 3 existing list tools: workspace_wherewithuser,systempromptvariable_get,slashcommandpreset_get
Normalize :id/:code parameter names and all tool-local references in 4 tools
known_limitations: No external LLM inference tool: workspacechat_new records caller-supplied prompt/response; other:record_chat_turn proposes this limited capability and is not llm_call.

document_adddocuments and workspaceparsedfile_movetodocumentsandembed create placeholder doc-seed/file/path rows, do not ingest pageContent or embed vectors; no document content read/search tool exists.
workspace_new does not derive slug and therefore is not advertised as complete workspace creation. Seed workspace ids and slugs with workspace().
workspacechat_new has an undeclared user mapping; recorded chat user_id can remain absent. Do not claim chat authorship attribution.

memory_search lacks a query argument in the raw panel and returns no keyword results; memory_create ignores workspace slug and sets workspaceId null; memory_demote contains a placeholder and cannot repoint an id-typed FK. Those operations are not advertised.
workspace_update resets chatProvider/chatModel to null in its original exec_spec; router_id is id-typed and its set is not writable. No configuration-preservation claim is made.
Some raw tools lack the authentication guards implied by their descriptions; onboarding preserves those guards and does not certify global authorization behavior.
document_update has no authentication guard and can update flags while signed out; this original behavior is preserved.
workspacesuggestedmessages_getmessages scopes workspaceId to the actor id rather than resolving workspaceSlug. Raw tools also lack full chat/thread history read/list APIs.
